heroHeadline: Death Toll Climbs to 31 as 104 Areas Remain Under Calamity, Fuel Prices Resume Rising
heroSubtitle: M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet storm sequence have killed 160+ across the cascade, with the August storm sequence alone affecting 7.7 million+ and 104 cities, municipalities and provinces now under a state of calamity as infrastructure damage nears ₱6 billion and diesel/gasoline prices resume climbing for a second straight week amid renewed Strait of Hormuz-linked supply disruption
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
